messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Suspected throughput regression observed in hosted-us-west-2 for text generation routes. p50 ~900ms -> 1.8s, p95 ~2.6s -> 5.1s over last 6m. Auto-page: on-call.

lina: oncall ack. seeing a big increase in inflight request count on gen-pool-usw2-3, disk i/o looks normal. KV cache hit ratio steady.

tech-oncall: digging into queuing; appears to be request batch sizes ballooning due to a client spike with large max_tokens. pulling logs now.

sam: adding metrics: `rbn metrics query --range 10m --metrics p95_latency, inflight, batch_size --filter region=us-west-2,route=/v1/generate`

sam: quick result: avg batch_size jumped from ~18 -> ~62 on the pool; inflight increased correspondingly.

mike: mitigation proposal: 1) throttle client-initiated large-batch requests at the gateway (reject >32 tokens) 2) spin up two extra inference workers in pool 3) add temporary routing to fallback region us-east-1 for non-urgent traffic.

lina: agree. start with the gateway throttle and spawn workers as parallel steps. I'm going to apply a temporary rate-limit rule that caps per-connection batch to 32 and returns 429 + Retry-After. command: ```bn gateway patch-rate-limit --region us-west-2 --route "/v1/generate" --max-batch 32 --response 429
```

incident-bot: Gateway rule applied. Returning 429 for batches > 32.

product-ops: drafting status page copy. Proposed short public message: "Weare investigating elevated generation latency in US-West (us-west-2). Some requests may be slower or receive temporary rate-limit responses. Engineers are mitigating; next update in 15 minutes."

cs-team: please add note for customers who rely on large-batch inference - include recommended client change: reduce batch sizes, exponential backoff, and retry with jitter. Template below for direct messages to affected customers.

cs-team: "Subject: Temporary slowdown & recommended client changes
Hi <Customer>,
Weobserved temporary slowdowns affecting text generation in US-West. We're applying mitigations (gateway throttles + extra capacity). If you use large batches, please reduce batch size to <= 32 and add standard retry/backoff. No data loss detected. We'll follow up with a full RCA.
Thanks, CS & Infra"

lina: spinning up 2 workers now: `rbn infra scale pool gen-pool-usw2-3 --count +2`

sre-bot: Scale operation started. New instances provisioning expected 90s.

sam: early numbers after gateway throttle: batch_size median drops to ~20 for inbound requests, p95 on canary worker nodes down from 5.1s -> 1.9s.

mike: initiating cross-region reroute for non-critical traffic: `rbn routing add --src-region us-west-2 --dst-region us-east-1 --match "route=/v1/generate AND priority!=high" --percent 30`

incident-bot: Routing change applied: 30% matched traffic -> us-east-1.

product-ops: posting public status update: "Investigating -> Mitigating: We identified elevated generation latency in US-West and have applied gateway throttles, added capacity, and rerouted some traffic. Partial recovery observed; customers may still see intermittent slowness or 429s. Next update in 30 minutes."

cs-team: queued targeted notifications for top 15 impacted tenants; will send once public update is live.

lina: metrics look stable after scale and throttle: region p95 now ~1.6s, error rates within expected. keeping monitors at tighter thresholds for next 90m.

sre-bot: Incident severity escalated to SEV-2 -> SEV-2 (paging paused). Handoff scheduled at 02:00 UTC. Next oncall: tech-oncall.

tech-oncall: taking handoff at 02:00 UTC. leaving notes in incident tracker: 
- Mitigations applied: gateway throttle (max_batch=32), +2 workers in gen-pool-usw2-3, 30% reroute to us-east-1.
- Owner for RCA: sam.
- Keep incident open for 2 hours post-stable metrics.

mike: suggest follow-up customer advisory once fully recovered: include timeline, root cause hypothesis (client-side spike in large-batch requests), and recommended client limits. Also add code snippet for SDK: 
```js
// SDK: cap batch size and retry
client.defaults.maxBatch = Math.min(client.defaults.maxBatch || 64, 32);
client.onRetry = (attempt) => Math.min(1000 * 2**attempt, 8000) + jitter();
```

product-ops: acknowledged. Will prepare post-recovery status and a more formal customer-facing note.

incident-bot: NOTE: Incident update posted to public status page. Monitoring continues. Incident channel will be used for follow-ups and RCA prep.

lina: thanks team. if we see regressions we'll re-open paging. otherwise we'll aim to close after 2h of stable p95 < 2s.

cs-team: sending the queued DMs now to impacted orgs. will attach monitoring screenshots and our recommended temporary configs.

tech-oncall: leaving shift; handing to sam. sam, ping if anything changes.

sam: got it. will monitor and start RCA notes.

incident-bot: Incident channel archived for follow-up once closed.
